summary: Frontend-only test (continuation of iteration 5). All requested flows PASSED on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844: commercial walkthrough request ?type=pub full 6-step flow (photo upload, visit date/time, details, address+postcode at end, confirmation text exact), ?type=xyz starts at step 1; admin /admin/walkthroughs sheet shows readable labels, photo grid (1 img loaded), requested visit; mobile admin sign-out works; residential /quote Regular flow (no address on property step, address/postcode required at step 6 with invalid postcode message, terms acceptance, review shows address + full total, 'Pay £87.00 & confirm' with no deposit, redirect to checkout.stripe.com); End of Tenancy flow (furnished/flooring on property step, address at end, 'Pay £240.00 & confirm'); Commercial service on /quote shows walkthrough link to /commercial-cleaning/request; mobile /quote no overflow on any step, stepper scrolls active step into view, mobile call bar hidden on /quote.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Type of cleaning required' shows raw enum key ('regular'/'deep') instead of label 'Regular contract cleaning'. cleaning_type is not in ENUM_KEYS and FIELD values are not mapped to CLEAN_TYPES labels.
After submit the page is not scrolled to top; the confirmation card's top (check icon) sits under the sticky header on desktop.

issues: Visit date / start date / alt date use native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy US format) while /quote uses the shadcn Calendar - inconsistent layout and US date format for a UK business
Selected slot and calendar today/selected day use teal colours (border-teal-600/bg-teal-50) - off-brand vs Solid Clean green #023F00 / gold #8F7E22

Mobile call bar + floating chat button are shown on /commercial-cleaning/request (hidden only on /quote); chat bubble overlaps form inputs while scrolling. Consider hiding on the request form too for consistency

action_items: Map cleaning_type (and frequency) values to human labels in admin walkthrough detail
Scroll to top when walkthrough confirmation shows
Optional: replace native date inputs in CommercialRequest with shadcn Calendar/Popover (UK format) for consistency with /quote
Optional: replace teal slot/calendar colours with brand colours; hide mobile call bar on /commercial-cleaning/request
critical_code_review_comments: Walkthroughs.jsx: import of '@/lib/api' placed after `const ENUM_KEYS` declaration (works due to hoisting but violates import/first lint)

QuotePage: label logic still supports deposit (`deposit < total`); backend preview currently returns deposit == total so full payment is shown - fine, but deposit code paths in QuotePage/StepReview are dead code if deposits are no longer a business rule
Postcode validation /^[A-Za-z]{1,2}\d/ is very loose (e.g. 'N1' or 'A1XXXX' passes); consider full UK postcode regex
End of Tenancy: 'Is the property furnished?' is not required - Continue enabled without a choice (review then shows no Furnished row)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed; 2 low-priority UI bugs + design notes
